subject: Request: Extension & Make-good Credits — onramp integration delay
messages:
From: Alex Yu <alex@clearlens.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@clearlens.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onramp: integration snag — ask for extension and credits

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. We ran into an unexpected blocker this morning while wiring up ClearLens’s onramp to Redwood: the auth handshake intermittently fails for our staging queue and it’s taking longer to reproduce than we expected. Our eng lead has flagged it as a priority but it will slip our demo window by ~2 weeks.

Given the delay, we wanted to ask if Redwood can: 1) grant a 30-day trial extension on our pilot window, and 2) issue a temporary sandbox credit top-up (roughly 60k tokens) so our QA run and extra debug cycles don’t exhaust the current sandbox.

I attached the staging error log and the updated integration diagram; Priya and I can jump on a call with your engs if useful. This is a time-sensitive ask — demo is now targeted for Aug 9 and we want to preserve momentum.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Yu
Head of Platform Integrations, ClearLens
alex@clearlens.io | +1 (415) 555-0119
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Alex Yu <alex@clearlens.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: integration snag — ask for extension and credits

Alex — thanks for the context and the logs (got them). Sorry to hear about the auth flake; that’s exactly the kind of issue we want to avoid derailing a pilot.

Quick plan: I’ll loop in Ben (pilot credits owner) and Marissa (AP/finance lead) to see what we can do for a short-term sandbox top-up and a 30-day extension. Can you confirm the minimum tokens you need for a full QA pass and how many parallel runs your team expects to run this week? That will help Ben size the credit top-up.

Also, please add the failing request/trace IDs to the JIRA ticket ONRAMP-312 so our infra team can correlate with logs. If you’re available later today, set a 30-min touch with Ben and our eng (cc’ed) — we’ll prioritize.

Hannah
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Alex Yu <alex@clearlens.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: integration snag — ask for extension and credits

Thanks for the signal, Hannah and Alex. I reviewed the logs and the expected QA footprint. Proposal from our side:

- Approve a 30-day pilot extension (no contract change)
- Provision a temporary sandbox top-up equivalent to ~60,000 tokens (our internal estimate ~$1,200 retail)
- Condition: we require ONRAMP-312 to show at least one merged PR from ClearLens’s team or an engineering note indicating a planned fix with ETA within 7 days — this avoids open-ended top-ups.

If Marissa signs off we can apply the credits today and update the HubSpot deal. Marissa — tagging you for approval and any billing/record steps. Dev, please standby for a short sync to triage the handshake traces.

Cheers,
Ben
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Alex Yu <alex@clearlens.io>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onramp: integration snag — ask for extension and credits

Ben/Hannah/Alex — approved with conditions below.

Approval summary:
- 30-day extension: approved (system updated).
- Sandbox credit: 60,000 tokens granted as temporary promo credit.

Conditions:
1) ClearLens to update ONRAMP-312 with at least one merged PR or a documented rollback/mitigation plan within 7 days.
2) We’ll schedule a 30-min post-fix review with Dev to confirm the failure case is resolved before any further credit increases.
3) Promo credits expire 45 days from issuance if not consumed; excess usage will be billed at standard pilot rates.

Alex — we’ll apply the credits by EOD Monday once the JIRA ticket is populated. Please confirm when ONRAMP-312 is updated and ping me if you need the DocuSign amendment for the extended window — I’ve attached the quick amendment template to the deal (HubSpot link above).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance & Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
